questions.question: Which conditional-expression program produces the required output? (maximum of two)
options:
a = 8
b = 5
result = "b is larger" if a > b else "a is larger"
print(result)

a = 8
b = 5
result = "b is larger" if a > b else "b is larger"
print(result)

a = 8
b = 5
result = "a is larger" if not (a > b) else "b is larger"
print(result)

a = 8
b = 5
result = "a is larger" if a > b else "b is larger"
print(result)
questions.answer:
a = 8
b = 5
result = "a is larger" if a > b else "b is larger"
print(result)
questions.explanation: The value before if is selected because a > b is True.
